product.name: Counseling and Therapy for Mental Health
product.description: Remote counseling and therapy services for mental health conditions including depression, anxiety, trauma, PTSD, ADHD, and mood disorders.

product.name: Psychological Evaluation for Surgical Clearance
product.description: Remote psychological assessments to evaluate patient readiness for surgery or neuromodulation procedures with results delivered within 24 hours.

identifier.value: Psychological Evaluation for General Mental Health

product.name: Psychological Evaluation for General Mental Health
product.description: Remote comprehensive mental health assessments for conditions like anxiety, depression, trauma, and mood disorders with reports delivered within 24 hours.

product.name: Trauma Counseling and Therapy
product.description: Virtual trauma-focused counseling to help individuals process and recover from traumatic experiences including PTSD.

product.name: Health, Wellness and Pain Coaching
product.description: Virtual coaching services focused on managing life challenges, chronic pain, emotional resilience, and personal growth.

product.name: Medication Titration Counseling
product.description: Remote counseling to support safe adjustment of medication dosages and manage withdrawal symptoms and mental health challenges.
